items.title: Skeleton Flying a Kite
items.alt: A friendly skeleton in a red scarf braces both feet while holding a reel and line attached to one simple diamond kite.
items.description: A friendly skeleton in a red scarf braces both feet while holding a reel and line attached to one simple diamond kite. Use this illustration for windy-day story cards and personal crafts.

items.title: Skeleton Playing Maracas
